dataset.scope: Essential controls for Indian 2W and LMV (4W) learners

controls.label: Left mirror
controls.description: Adjust before moving off so you can see traffic behind without turning your head fully.

controls.label: Speedometer / instrument cluster
controls.description: Shows speed, fuel, odometer and warning lights (engine, oil, indicators). Glance briefly — never stare while riding.

controls.label: Right mirror
controls.description: Pair with the left mirror for a clear rear view on both sides.

controls.label: Clutch lever (left hand)
controls.description: Pull in to disengage the engine from the rear wheel when changing gears or stopping. Release smoothly when moving off.

controls.label: Indicator switch
controls.description: Toggle left or right turn signal. Cancel after the turn; many switches auto-cancel on newer bikes.

controls.label: Headlight / pass switch
controls.description: Controls headlamp modes. Use dipped (low) beam in traffic; flash pass beam only to alert, not to dazzle.

controls.label: Horn button
controls.description: Warn others of your presence. Use sparingly in built-up areas; required in some hazard situations.

controls.label: Engine kill switch
controls.description: Emergency cut-off on the right bar. Flip to OFF to stop the engine quickly; must be ON to start.

controls.label: Front brake lever (right hand)
controls.description: Operates the front disc/drum brake. Provides most of your stopping power — squeeze progressively, not abruptly.

controls.label: Throttle grip (right hand)
controls.description: Twist back to accelerate, release to slow. Keep a relaxed grip; roll off before braking.

controls.label: Ignition key
controls.description: Insert and turn to ON before starting. Remove when parking to prevent theft.

controls.label: Gear shift lever (left foot)
controls.description: Typical pattern: 1-N-2-3-4-5 (and sometimes 6). Half-click up from 1st finds neutral.

controls.label: Rear brake pedal (right foot)
controls.description: Rear wheel brake. Use together with the front brake for balanced stopping; avoid locking the rear wheel.

variants.title: Scooter (automatic 2W)
variants.subtitle: No clutch — brake levers and twist throttle

controls.label: Left mirror
controls.description: Check adjustment before every ride for a clear rear view.

controls.label: Dashboard (speed / fuel)
controls.description: Speedometer, fuel gauge and tell-tale lights. On many scooters the entire unit sits in the handlebar fairing.

controls.label: Right mirror
controls.description: Adjust so you see the lane behind, not your elbow.

controls.label: Left brake lever (often rear brake)
controls.description: On most Indian scooters this lever operates the rear brake. Confirm on your model before riding.

controls.label: Indicator switch
controls.description: Signal before turning or changing lanes; cancel after the manoeuvre.

controls.label: Headlight switch
controls.description: Turn headlamp ON for night riding; many cities require daytime running lights.

controls.label: Horn button
controls.description: Usually on the left switch block. Use to warn, not to rush others.

controls.label: Right brake lever (front brake)
controls.description: Primary stopping force on scooters. Squeeze smoothly with the rear brake for stable stops.

controls.label: Throttle grip
controls.description: Twist to go; automatic transmission changes ratio — no clutch or gear lever.

controls.label: Ignition key / power button
controls.description: Key slot or push-button start after turning ON. Some scooters have a seat-lock under the key.

controls.label: Side stand
controls.description: Fold up fully before moving; many scooters cut engine if ridden with stand down.

controls.label: Floorboard & foot position
controls.description: Keep feet flat and clear of moving parts. Avoid dragging feet while turning.

controls.label: Inside rear-view mirror
controls.description: Centre mirror to see traffic behind. Adjust from your normal driving seat before moving.

controls.label: Instrument cluster
controls.description: Speedometer, fuel, engine temperature and warning lamps (battery, oil, ABS, airbag).

controls.label: Steering wheel
controls.description: Turn left/right to steer. Hold at 9-and-3 or 10-and-2; never wrap arms through the wheel.

controls.label: Horn (wheel centre)
controls.description: Press the pad at the centre of the wheel. Use for warning, not aggression.

controls.label: Indicator stalk (left of wheel)
controls.description: Push up for right indicator, down for left. Usually also controls high-beam flash on many cars.

controls.label: Wiper & washer stalk
controls.description: Controls front wipers and washer spray. Use appropriate speed for rain intensity.

controls.label: Ignition key / start button
controls.description: Key turn or push-button start (often with foot on brake in automatics).

controls.label: Gear lever / automatic selector
controls.description: Manual: H-pattern stick with clutch. Automatic: P-R-N-D-L — always brake before shifting.

controls.label: Handbrake / parking brake
controls.description: Pull up (or foot pedal) to hold the car when parked on a slope. Release fully before driving.

controls.label: Hazard warning switch
controls.description: Red triangle button — all indicators flash together. Use when stopped and blocking traffic or in breakdown.

controls.label: AC / blower controls
controls.description: Fan speed, temperature and air direction. Demist the windscreen before driving in rain or fog.

controls.label: Clutch pedal (manual only)
controls.description: Leftmost pedal — press when changing gears and when stopping in gear.

controls.label: Brake pedal
controls.description: Middle pedal (manual) or left of two (automatic). Press firmly and progressively to stop.

controls.label: Accelerator pedal
controls.description: Rightmost pedal — controls engine speed. Ease off before braking.
